# Security & Input Validation Checklist: Taskify Kanban Board (Phase 1)

**Purpose**: Quick author self-check of how well the security and input-validation requirements
are written, across the spec and plan documents, before `/speckit-tasks`
**Created**: 2026-10-08
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) · [plan.md](../plan.md) · [data-model.md](../data-model.md) ·
[contracts/api.md](../contracts/api.md) · [research.md](../research.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 - Are maximum counts defined for every collection (projects, tasks per project, comments per task), as Constitution Principle II requires for "every text field, collection, and upload"? [Gap, Constitution §II, Spec §Input Validation]
  - Accepted: no request body contains a collection, and every body is capped at 64 KiB (Contract §Request rules). Stored record counts are not input, and only this computer can reach the app (FR-006).
- [x] CHK002 - Are validation rules for the configuration inputs `-port` and `-data` written down next to the other inputs, rather than only claimed in the Constitution Check? [Gap, Plan §Constitution Check, Research R3, R6]
  - Fixed: Data Model §Configuration inputs.
- [x] CHK003 - Is it specified that system-set fields (`id`, `projectId`, `taskId`, `authorId`, `createdBy`, `createdAt`) are refused when a client sends them in a request body, for every write route? [Completeness, Data Model §Entities, Contract §Request rules]
  - Fixed: Contract §Request rules (any unlisted field, including system-set fields, → 400).
- [x] CHK004 - Are the security events to be logged, and the data that must never appear in logs, stated in a requirement or contract rather than only in a research decision? [Completeness, Research R11, Constitution §Security Requirements]
  - Covered: Plan §Constitution Check (Sec: Logging) and Research R11 list the events to log and say submitted values are never logged.
- [x] CHK005 - Are protection requirements stated for the data file on disk (who may read or change it), given it holds all Taskify data unencrypted? [Gap, Data Model §Storage file, Research R3]
  - Covered: Data Model §Storage file and Research R3 set the file to mode `0600`, so only its owner can read or change it.

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK006 - Does "no invisible control characters" state whether invisible Unicode format characters (such as right-to-left override U+202E or zero-width space U+200B) are allowed, given the plan allows them? [Ambiguity, Spec §Input Validation, Research R7]
  - Accepted: format characters stay allowed because emoji need them (Research R7); all user text is shown with `textContent` only (Research R8).
- [x] CHK007 - Are "character" (code point or what a person sees) and "only spaces" (U+0020 only, or all Unicode whitespace) defined in the spec with the same meaning the data model uses? [Clarity, Spec §Input Validation, Data Model §Validation definitions]
  - Covered: Data Model §Validation definitions defines a character as a code point and "Required" as non-empty after ignoring surrounding whitespace.
- [x] CHK008 - Is it stated exactly which data may be shown before a user is picked (the five names and roles only)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002, Contract §GET /api/users]
  - Covered: Contract §Request rules requires `X-Taskify-User` on every route except `GET /api/users`, so only the five names and roles are shown before a user is picked.

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK009 - Are the spec's input values mapped explicitly to their API forms (column names to `todo`/`in_progress`/`in_review`/`done`, "Empty" assignee to `0`), including that `null` means "not provided" and does not clear an assignee? [Consistency, Spec §Input Validation, Contract §PATCH task]
  - Fixed: Contract §Field values (column-to-status table, `assigneeId` 0) and Contract §Request rules (`null` → 400).
- [x] CHK010 - Does FR-025 say, as the contract does, that error messages never repeat the submitted value or an unknown field's name? [Consistency, Spec §FR-025, Contract §Error body, Constitution §II]
  - Covered: Contract §Error body says messages never contain the submitted value or an unknown field's name; FR-025 does not conflict with it.

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK011 - Does SC-005 require values on both sides of each limit (e.g., 200 characters accepted and 201 refused), not just one breaking value? [Measurability, Spec §SC-005]
  - Fixed: Spec §SC-005 (exact limit accepted, limit + 1 refused); Quickstart and Research R10 match.

## Scenario & Edge Case Coverage

- [x] CHK012 - Does FR-006 cover requests sent through a browser on the same computer by other websites (cross-site requests, DNS rebinding), with a measurable criterion like the one SC-009 gives for other computers? [Coverage, Gap, Spec §FR-006, Spec §SC-009, Research R6]
  - Covered: Research R6 adds the `Host` allowlist (DNS rebinding) and `CrossOriginProtection` (cross-site); Contract §Request rules returns 421 and 403; Quickstart lists automated and `curl` checks for both.
- [x] CHK013 - Does FR-026 list every place user text appears (card, task dialog, project list, comment list, browser tab title, error messages), so none is left out? [Coverage, Spec §FR-026]
  - Covered: Research R8 makes `textContent`/`value` the only way user text is shown anywhere, and an automated test fails if `app.js` contains `innerHTML` (Research R10).
- [x] CHK014 - Is the required behavior defined when the server refuses the picked user partway through a session (401), such as returning to the user picker? [Exception Flow, Gap, Spec §FR-002, Contract §Request rules]
  - Accepted: a 401 partway through a session only happens if local storage is tampered with; the UI returns to the user picker (Research R9).

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [x] CHK015 - Are the conditions that end phase 1's accepted risks (no login, plain HTTP) stated as requirements, for example that login and HTTPS are required before FR-006 may allow other computers? [Assumption, Spec §Access Rules, Research R13, Plan §Constitution Check]
  - Accepted: ending phase 1's risks belongs to a later phase's spec; the constitution already requires HTTPS then.

## Notes

- Depth: quick self-check (15 items). Audience: the author, before `/speckit-tasks`.
- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Add comments or findings inline
- Link to relevant resources or documentation
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
